preflight.scope: Two authorized GET preflights; no business writes or live database read by the auditor.

limitations: Only explicit Accept:image/jpeg, w3840/q75 was requested; no-header and other Accept combinations, widths, or formats are not separately HTTP tested.

Original source files from the prior188source capture are reused read-only and SHA-verified; no fresh upstream body capture or source-byte-lineage proof was added. HIT/MISS alone does not prove current CDN byte identity.
No-upscale comparisons are explicitly against those approved captured source dimensions, not freshly downloaded source metadata.
A matching original SHA plus retained source ICC identifies original-byte passthrough for these nonanimatedJPEG sources; HTTP does not expose the optimizer exception itself.
The representation body sum is audit workload, not initial page transfer. Future uploads/brand logos are outside188productsource coverage.
Metadata inspection saves presence flags and dimensions only; no metadata values or source URLs are persisted. Visual comparison is separately recorded.
